TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES
JIRA | Azure DevOps | Confluence | Microsoft Visio | SharePoint | Power BI | Shopify | Shopify Plus | Guidewire ClaimCenter | Dynamics 365 | Azure Data Factory | Microsoft Purview | SQL | REST APIs | Postman | FHIR | EDI X12 | Razorpay | Stripe | SAP Commerce | OMS | WMS | TFS | Workday | D365
CORE COMPETENCIES
Product Ownership & Product Lifecycle Management • Business Analysis & Requirements Management • Agile Scrum, Sprint Planning & Backlog Grooming • User Story Mapping & Acceptance Criteria • BRD, FRD, FSD, Use Cases & Process Modeling • Stakeholder & Vendor Management • GenAI, OCR, Data Classification & Vectorization • Digital Commerce & Shopify Plus • OMS, WMS, ERP & API Integrations • UAT, SIT, Defect Management & Traceability • Data Analytics, KPI Tracking & Reporting • Risk, Dependency & Change Management 
Tools & Technologies
Workday HCM | Workday Recruiting | Talent Management | Compensation | Absence Management | Workday Reporting | EIB | Workday Studio | JIRA | Azure DevOps | Power BI | ServiceNow | Active Directory | REST APIs | SQL | Agile Scrum
Key Achievements
Streamlined employee lifecycle processes through automation and workflow optimization. • Improved HR operational efficiency by reducing manual interventions across onboarding and talent management processes. • Enhanced workforce reporting accuracy through centralized employee data and real-time analytics. • Successfully delivered Workday enhancements and integrations within Agile release cycles while maintaining stakeholder alignment. Oct 2019 – Jun 2021
Elicited and documented business, functional, and regulatory requirements for healthcare claims processing systems. • Facilitated workshops, stakeholder interviews, and JAD sessions with business and compliance teams. • Developed BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process flows, and requirements traceability matrices. • Created AS-IS and TO-BE workflows covering claims intake, adjudication, eligibility verification, pre-authorizations, and EOB processing. • Collaborated with solution architects and development teams on Guidewire ClaimCenter integrations. • Defined data mapping requirements and validated Azure Data Factory migration pipelines. • Supported API, FHIR, and EDI X12 integrations with healthcare partners, TPAs, and clearinghouses. • Ensured HIPAA and ACA compliance through business process and data governance controls. • Led UAT planning, execution, defect management, and stakeholder sign-offs. • Worked with BI teams to define operational dashboards and claims reporting using Power BI.
Project -1 : Retail Banking Santander, UK
May 2017 – Oct 2019
Gathered, analyzed, and documented business requirements for mortgage and financial services applications. • Developed BRDs, Functional Design Documents, user stories, use cases, and business process models. • Collaborated with project managers and technical teams to define project scope, delivery timelines, and release plans. • Facilitated Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. • Managed requirements traceability, change requests, defect triage, and stakeholder communications. • Coordinated SIT, UAT, production deployments, and business sign-offs. • Created user manuals, training materials, and knowledge transfer documentation. • Utilized JIRA, TFS, SharePoint, and Visio to support project delivery and governance activities. ACADEMICS Post Graduate, University of Bedfordshire Uk. Mar 2017 Computer Applications (Fulltime) Bachelor of Science, Nagarjuna University, Guntur. Computer Science (Fulltime) CBAP from IIBA, 2019 CSPO from Scrum Alliance, 2020 Functional Consultant in AI from IIT Kanpur 2023

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Product Owner / Senior Business Analyst | Bank Of America (KMB IT Systems) Dec 2023 – Present
Project: GenAI-Powered Loan Application Processing & Credit Underwriting Transformation
Partnering with Lending Operations, Risk, Compliance, Underwriting, and Data Science teams to modernize the end-to-end loan origination and application processing lifecycle using Generative AI and Intelligent Automation solutions.
Lead requirements gathering and business process analysis for AI-enabled loan processing workflows covering customer onboarding, document intake, KYC verification, income assessment, credit evaluation, and underwriting support. • Collaborate with AI/ML teams to implement Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) solutions leveraging OCR, NLP, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures for automated extraction and validation of loan application documents. • Define business rules, data classification frameworks, and metadata requirements for processing financial statements, income proofs, bank statements, tax documents, identity verification documents, and supporting loan artifacts. • Drive the design and implementation of Agentic AI workflows capable of orchestrating multi-step loan assessment activities including document verification, exception handling, fraud checks, policy validation, and underwriting recommendations. • Coordinate cross-functional teams for data mapping, vector database preparation, document chunking strategies, embeddings generation, knowledge base creation, and AI model training readiness. • Support synthetic data generation initiatives to enhance model training, testing, validation, and performance benchmarking while maintaining regulatory and data privacy standards. • Define user stories, business requirements, acceptance criteria, and workflow specifications for AI copilots and underwriting assistants supporting lending operations teams. • Collaborate with engineering teams on prompt engineering, AI workflow orchestration, human-in-the-loop review processes, model evaluation frameworks, and continuous improvement initiatives. • Facilitate integration requirements between AI platforms, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), CRM platforms, document management systems, workflow engines, and enterprise data repositories. • Lead validation activities for AI-generated outputs including document extraction accuracy, classification confidence scoring, summarization quality, and decision-support recommendations. • Establish governance controls for AI explainability, auditability, model monitoring, risk management, compliance reviews, and responsible AI adoption. • Manage Agile delivery processes including backlog prioritization, sprint planning, stakeholder reviews, dependency management, release planning, and deployment coordination. • Monitor key business metrics including loan processing turnaround time, document extraction accuracy, underwriting efficiency, straight-through processing rates, and operational cost reduction within D365 platform Jul 2021 – Nov 2023
Gathered and analyzed business requirements for enterprise-scale digital commerce transformation initiatives. • Conducted stakeholder workshops and process discovery sessions to define customer journeys, fulfillment workflows, and pricing models. • Authored BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and business rules. • Managed product backlog, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews in Agile Scrum environments. • Collaborated with development teams on Shopify configurations, API integrations, and third-party application implementations. • Defined requirements for OMS, ERP, WMS, payment gateway, and logistics integrations. • Tracked KPIs including Conversion Rate, Cart Abandonment, Order Fulfillment Time, Inventory Turnover, and Average Order Value. • Coordinated UAT activities, defect resolution, and production releases. • Improved checkout experience and order processing efficiency through process optimization initiatives. Key Achievements: • Increased conversion rates by 20% through customer journey and checkout optimization. • Reduced order processing time by 30% through OMS and warehouse integration enhancements. • Enabled real-time inventory visibility across multiple warehouse locations.
Project 1: Workday HCM & Talent Management Transformation Project Description
Led business analysis activities for the implementation and enhancement of Workday HCM, Talent Management, Compensation, and Recruiting modules for a global enterprise workforce. The initiative focused on modernizing HR
operations, improving employee experience, automating workforce processes, and enabling real-time workforce analytics through Workday and integrated enterprise applications.
Business Objectives
Standardize global HR processes across multiple regions and business units. • Automate employee lifecycle management from hire to retire. • Improve talent acquisition, performance management, and compensation planning. • Enable workforce reporting and HR analytics through centralized data management. • Integrate Workday with Payroll, Identity Management, ERP, and third-party HR applications.
Key Responsibilities • Conducted stakeholder workshops with HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Compliance, and IT teams to gather and analyze business requirements. • Documented Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Documents (FRD), process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria. • Configured and validated requirements for Workday HCM, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, Absence Management, and Security roles. • Facilitated requirement discussions for employee onboarding, offboarding, job changes, promotions, transfers, and organizational restructuring processes. • Collaborated with Workday consultants and solution architects to define business processes, security models, and reporting requirements. • Defined integration requirements between Workday and Payroll, Active Directory, ERP, ServiceNow, and third-party HR systems. • Participated in data migration activities including employee master data validation, cleansing, mapping, and reconciliation. • Supported Workday EIB, Workday Studio, and API-based integration requirements. • Managed product backlog, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and sprint reviews in Agile Scrum environments. • Coordinated SIT, UAT, defect management, and business sign-off activities. • Partnered with reporting teams to define HR dashboards and workforce analytics using Workday Reporting and Power BI. • Ensured compliance with organizational security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
